summary: Configured `inventory-worker` as an enabled systemd service running `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker`. After rebooting node1, the boot ID changed and the service automatically recovered in the active/running state.
actions_performed: Captured the healthy pre-reboot service and boot identity baseline.
Safely rebooted node1 and polled until it returned.
Verified the changed boot identity, healthy system state, persistent worker binary, and automatically restarted service.

evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, systemd reported the unit loaded, active, and running; its live process command line identified `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker`.
The enable operation created the multi-user target link. Following an actual node reboot, the unit remained enabled and was started by systemd during the new boot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence.
evidence.summary: The baseline boot ID was `f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1`; systemd acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot; node1 returned with boot ID `c16d7a44-994f-4d92-b52f-6feff1dcb1f6`; post-reboot checks showed system state `running`, the service enabled/active, a stable live PID, matching worker checksum, and a current-boot systemd start journal entry.
